text:
tom: Heads up — GCP Marketplace invoice INV-2026-0502 shows a reclassification credit for reseller NimbleChannels. Credit amount $12,760 and we don't have a matching refund approval. @rachel can you take a look?

rachel: i'll pull the settlement detail now. do we have the settlement id or adjustment code? could be a usage reclass (skus moved between tiers).

gcp-marketplace-bot: Notification: Adjustment recorded for account 'nimblechannels' on invoice INV-2026-0502. Adjustment ID: GADJ-44211. Category: Reclassification Credit.

tom: CSV snippet from the portal (redacted):

```
invoice_id,account,sku,amount,reason
INV-2026-0502,nimblechannels,rdw-embeddings-tier2,-12760.00,reclass: seats moved to partner-tier1
```

rachel: that "reclass" text suggests the partner disputed seat tiering and GCP applied a settlement-level reclass. i see two transactions in our channel-sync logs where tier assignment changed during Mar billing sweep. grep shows `tier_sync:nimble / change:2->1 / count:128`. attaching lines to FIN-2520.

kevin: since this is under $15k our standard policy allows Sr. Finance Manager approval rather than VP. rachel, please prepare a short memo with evidence + recommended GL entry. proposed GL: "4102 - Partner Credits" + note tag "GCP Reclass".

rachel: will prepare. also quick sanity check: confirm AR won't double-credit the reseller if we post internal refund. marketplace may have already adjusted their payout. need to reconcile in our bank feed.

tom: good catch. Nimble opened a ticket confirming they accepted the credit but asked for an invoice-level note so their accounting matches. forwarding them FIN-2520 link.

rachel: draft memo done, added line items, timeline, and reconcile steps to JIRA FIN-2520: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2520. tagging kevin for approval.

kevin: approved. go ahead and post GL adjustment with memo reference. please use memo id FIN-2520 and code GADJ-44211.

rachel: posting now. updating AR ledger and marking payout as "reconciled" in channel-recon. will also flag for monthly close impact: -$12.76k to revenue, record in month close notes.

tom: thanks team. rachel — please confirm once the bank feed shows no duplicate payout.

rachel: will monitor overnight and update FIN-2520. :white_check_mark:

gcp-marketplace-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 24h for Adjustment GADJ-44211 to confirm payout reconciliation.
__notes: Slack thread in finance about a GCP Marketplace reclassification credit for a reseller (NimbleChannels). Contains CSV snippet, logs reference, JIRA ticket, approval, and reconciliation steps. Messages are short and realistic.
